**Original comment by Danny Heijl (Bitbucket: [dheijl](https://bitbucket.org/dheijl), GitHub: [dheijl](https://github.com/dheijl)).**

----------------------------------------

Did some testing with ASAN and so far the only error I got was a heap buffer overrun when closing down ART \(see ASAN2.pdf for the stacktrace and ASAN report\).

This looks more difficult to figure out… It looks like the EditDataProvider has already been destroyed \(ImageArea destructor\) when it gets referenced further on in the Spot::on\_hide\(\) callback set in the Spot constructor.

> 0x6140000cf270 is located 48 bytes inside of 440-byte region \[0x6140000cf240,0x6140000cf3f8\)  
> freed by thread T0 here:  
> \#0 0x7ffff6efb2c0 in operator delete\(void\*\) \(/usr/lib/x86\_64-linux-gnu/libasan.so.4\+0xe12c0\)  
> ~~#1~~ 0x55555645384b in ImageArea::~ImageArea\(\) /home/danny/programs/code-art/rtgui/imagearea.cc:72  
> ~~#2~~ 0x55555645df28 in ImageAreaPanel::~ImageAreaPanel\(\) /home/danny/programs/code-art/rtgui/imageareapanel.cc:43  
> ~~#3~~ 0x55555645dfab in ImageAreaPanel::~ImageAreaPanel\(\) /home/danny/programs/code-art/rtgui/imageareapanel.cc:44  
> ~~#4~~ 0x555556156678 in EditorPanel::~EditorPanel\(\) /home/danny/programs/code-art/rtgui/editorpanel.cc:857  
> ~~#5~~ 0x555556157633 in EditorPanel::~EditorPanel\(\) /home/danny/programs/code-art/rtgui/editorpanel.cc:932  
> ~~#6~~ 0x7ffff58c899a in g\_datalist\_clear \(/usr/lib/x86\_64-linux-gnu/libglib-2.0.so.0\+0x2e99a\)
>
> previously allocated by thread T0 here:  
> \#0 0x7ffff6efa448 in operator new\(unsigned long\) \(/usr/lib/x86\_64-linux-gnu/libasan.so.4\+0xe0448\)  
> ~~#1~~ 0x55555645d88f in ImageAreaPanel::ImageAreaPanel\(\) /home/danny/programs/code-art/rtgui/imageareapanel.cc:24  
> ~~#2~~ 0x55555614c0d6 in EditorPanel::EditorPanel\(FilePanel\*\) /home/danny/programs/code-art/rtgui/editorpanel.cc:574  
> ~~#3~~ 0x5555567980eb in RTWindow::createSetmEditor\(\) /home/danny/programs/code-art/rtgui/rtwindow.cc:1145  
> ~~#4~~ 0x55555678b5b3 in RTWindow::RTWindow\(\) /home/danny/programs/code-art/rtgui/rtwindow.cc:370  
> ~~#5~~ 0x555556504c1e in create\_rt\_window /home/danny/programs/code-art/rtgui/main.cc:257  
> ~~#6~~ 0x555556507fb0 in main /home/danny/programs/code-art/rtgui/main.cc:566  
> ~~#7~~ 0x7ffff11a5b96 in \_\_libc\_start\_main \(/lib/x86\_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6\+0x21b96\)

‌

Not sure I’m up to figuring this one out.
